commit e484d04a0fc187f10e0ea4555224b5e8753c17fd
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Dec 5 10:06:14 2024 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Dec 5 10:06:14 2024 +0000

    Bug 1933544 - Set chunk size for non-shippable l10n tasks. r=dandarnell
    
    These tasks are not normally run. Used mostly when testing on try-c-c.
    Without a chunk size the single task ran too long.
    
    HG Enter commit message.  Lines beginning with 'HG:' are removed.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D230826

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
index 08c831c590d..0ce909aeb28 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/l10n/kind.yml
@@ -31,6 +31,7 @@ tasks:
         from-deps:
             group-by: platform
         locales-file: comm/mail/locales/onchange-locales
+        locales-per-chunk: 5
         ignore-locales:
             by-build-platform:
                 # OSX has a special locale for japanese
